scope: All 276 mapped Échezeaux parcels inventoried; all 36 recorded right-holder groups triaged. Not an exhaustive search of every cadastral reference or inaccessible archive.
rules: Candidate names are research hypotheses, never verified farmers.
Rights as of 2025-01-01, modern cadastral geometry and estate descriptions are different evidence.
A reviewed-at date or webpage crawl date is not a farming date.
Unmatched rights do not mean no owner or no farmer.
A cru intersection does not establish that the whole cadastral parcel is planted or farmed.
No automatic assignment from area, adjacency, named area, wine bottler, manager or similar company name.

exactParcelEvents.summary: Dossier 2022-204, complete at 21/10/2022, 1.5050 ha across Vosne-Romanée and Flagey-Échezeaux; the receipt does not authorise cultivation. Geometry of D0177/D0178 is unchanged since January 2022. Printed D01776 is unresolved.

exactParcelEvents.applicant: SAS Domaine RC Les Grandes Vignes (Quincey)
exactParcelEvents.summary: Application filed 11/01/2022, complete 01/03/2022, CDOA opinion 25/05/2022; the same decision refuses Vosne-Romanée AB references to this applicant. Article 2 lists four communes without assigning each row; the section D rows are taken as Flagey-Échezeaux because the cédant holds these references there. D0665 is printed at 0.1157 ha, its cadastral area; D0666 at 0.0799 ha against 0.1157 ha, so its scope is unresolved. D0667, held by the same right holder, is not in the decision. Whether the applicant is connected to Domaine Jean-Charles Rion is not established.

Dossier 2022-053, filed 07/03/2022, complete 28/03/2022; 0.7903 ha across Vosne-Romanée and Flagey-Échezeaux, all three Flagey references in Les Loächausses. The receipt is not an authorisation. D0774 was divided after January 2024.

Dossier 2022-113, filed 23/05/2022, with Vougeot A523/A524; 1.0719 ha in total. Both Flagey references are in Les Loächausses. The receipt states it does not authorise cultivation. D0775 was divided after January 2024.

accessGaps: CVI records require cooperation from authorised holders; no private records accessed.
Public CartoBio polygons omit operator identity.
HOR Vignobles and Coudray PDF full text/render unavailable; indexed excerpts retained only as leads.

Regional bulletins 2019–2026 were read for Côte-d'Or DDT notices (2026 up to the scan date). Farm-structure notices appear there regularly only from 2021; earlier notices, likely in the Côte-d'Or departmental bulletins, were not searched. The DDT notice page and cote-dor.gouv.fr refused automated access.
Cadastral lineage covers the 2019–2026 vintages only; earlier divisions are not traced.
Winehog Premium articles were not read beyond their public previews.

historyFindings.title: Nicole Lamarche entity was named after Domaine François Lamarche
historyFindings.finding: SIREN 397738634 is recorded as FONCIER VITI DOM FRANCOIS LAMARCHE on 1 January 2020 and 2021 and as NICOLE LAMARCHE from 2022. The unchanged SIREN proves one renamed legal entity, which strengthens the identity link to the Lamarche domaine. There was no company record in 2019. Farming of the three parcels remains unconfirmed.

historyFindings.title: Anne Gros company rights begin in 2021
historyFindings.finding: ANNE GROS (SIREN 348024928) first appears on 1 January 2021; both references existed in 2019 without a company record. This dates recorded rights, not an operating start.

historyFindings.title: 2022 application references match today's geometry
historyFindings.finding: Geometry and recorded area of D0177 and D0178 (and Grands-Échezeaux D0093) are identical in the 1 January 2022 vintage and today, so the printed references in the November 2022 receipt denote today's parcels. Neither Échezeaux reference has a company record in any year 2019–2025, consistent with private ownership. The application's outcome and actual operation remain unconfirmed; D01776 appears in no vintage.

historyFindings.title: D0673 left Mongeard-Mugneret during 2024
historyFindings.finding: Both references were held by ASSURANCES DU CREDIT MUTUEL VIE until 2020 and by DOMAINE MONGEARD MUGNERET (SIREN 303514681) from 2021. On 1 January 2025 D0673 is held by BOUCHON POURPRE (SIREN 880909346). A Mongeard lead for D0673 rests on rights that ended during 2024.

historyFindings.title: Capitain parcels moved to Capitain-Gagnerot in 2020
historyFindings.finding: GFA DOMAINE FRANCOIS CAPITAIN ET FILS (SIREN 339012320) through 2020, SARL CAPITAIN GAGNEROT (SIREN 515620466) from 2021. A different SIREN means a transfer between entities. Family-name continuity supports the existing lead without proving farming.

historyFindings.title: Clerget parcel moved into the domaine company in 2023
historyFindings.finding: GFV CHRISTIAN ET ISABELLE CLERGET (SIREN 430384354) through 2023, SCEV DU DOMAINE CHRISTIAN CLERGET (SIREN 431340140) from 2024. Ownership by the domaine company is closer to the operator, but it is not a lease or operation record.

historyFindings.title: HOR Vignobles transfer to SCI Les Climats dated to 2022
historyFindings.finding: D0815 passes from HOR VIGNOBLES to SCI LES CLIMATS between the 2022 and 2023 files, while D0813 and D0814 stay with HOR. This places the En Orveaux transfer suggested by the indexed HOR filing on D0815. The farmer remains unresolved.

historyFindings.title: Traversins rights start on 1 January 2024
historyFindings.finding: No company record through 2023; TRAVERSINS (SIREN 911887461) from 1 January 2024. The timing matches the 2023 report of additional Champs Traversins vines. That strengthens the lead's timing, not its parcel scope or farming.

historyFindings.title: U22079769 is an undivided-ownership placeholder for former D0143
historyFindings.finding: PROPRIETAIRES DU BND 267 D0143 held D0143 from 2019 to 2024. The 2025 cadastre divides D0143 into these five references and the same record follows. It denotes co-owners of undivided property, not a company to identify; ask the owners directly.

historyFindings.title: Family land companies first recorded in 2025
historyFindings.finding: GFA FAMILLE FOREY BJ, GROUPEMENT FONCIER VITICOLE DE ORVEAUX and LES CRUOTS first appear on 1 January 2025 on references that existed earlier without a company record. This is consistent with family land moving into land-holding companies during 2024. Their U-numbers carry no SIREN, so names remain leads only.

historyFindings.title: Other first company records, 2023–2024
historyFindings.finding: DOMAINE ARNOUX - LACHAUX (D0161), EARL DOMAINE FAIVRE (D0203) and DOMAINE D'EUGENIE (D0340) first appear on 1 January 2024, ORIGINE (D0313) on 1 January 2023. These are recent acquisitions or transfers into a company; ask for the deed or lease date together with operation evidence.

historyFindings.title: Romanée-Conti record reformatted, parcels unchanged
historyFindings.finding: The same four references move from a MAJIC-only record (2019) through a provisional U-number (2020) to SIREN 778269407 (2021), as SC DOM DE LA ROMANEE CONTI becomes DOMAINE DE LA ROMANEE CONTI. This is consistent with reformatting rather than a sale, but the file alone cannot prove identity.

historyFindings.title: Split parcels with no company record in any year
historyFindings.finding: These references were created by dividing earlier parcels after 2019. Neither they nor their predecessors carry a company record in any year, which points to private owners. The legal-entity files cannot identify them; only owners, notaries or shared CVI extracts can.

externalResearch.title: Hospices de Beaune, Cuvée Jean-Luc Bissey

Consistent with the 2019–2025 rights (HOSPICES CIVILS DE BEAUNE). Who cultivates for the Hospices is not stated.

externalResearch.title: Michel Noëllat, Échezeaux du Dessus — conflicts with recorded rights
externalResearch.finding: Winehog 2014 area; the parcel set is reconstructed by this register because the published area equals their exact cadastral sum. Winehog lists 0.5097 ha, not confirmed; these five references total 5 097 m². The recorded rights conflict: D0191/D0192 are held by GFA Mongeard Mugneret from 2019, D0671–D0673 by Mongeard companies (D0671/D0673 after Crédit Mutuel until 2020) and D0673 by Bouchon Pourpre from 2025. externalResearch.title: Liger-Belair added an Échezeaux du Dessus plot from 2020
externalResearch.finding: Winehog reports a new Échezeaux du Dessus plot from the 2020 vintage without its location. D0673, in Échezeaux du Dessus, passed from Mongeard to Bouchon Pourpre (a company connected with Comte Liger-Belair) during 2024. The dates are compatible but do not identify the plot.

externalResearch.title: Liger-Belair Échezeaux holdings before 2020
externalResearch.finding: Six plots totalling 0.6157 ha: two in Les Cruots ou Vignes Blanches (0.3299 ha), Champs Traversins and Clos Saint-Denis. No cadastral references; a research target for those climats.

externalResearch.title: Les Loächausses: former Gros Frère et Sœur monopole
externalResearch.finding: Winehog (2011) describes Les Loächausses as formerly a Gros Frère et Sœur monopole and lists Gros Frère et Sœur and Anne Gros there. The 2022 applications by Michel Gros and AF Gros cover D0181, D0184, D0558, D0774 and D0775 in Les Loächausses, and ANNE GROS holds D0183/D0709 there from 2021, consistent with a division of that holding.

externalResearch.title: Berthaut-Gerbet enlarged its Échezeaux from 2018
externalResearch.finding: Winehog says Amélie Berthaut took over the old Gerbet holdings and enlarged the Échezeaux from the 2018 vintage. These are the Gerbet Sirugue GFA references; the article preview does not say which parcels are farmed.

externalResearch.title: Grivot in Les Cruots ou Vignes Blanches
externalResearch.finding: Winehog names Domaine Jean Grivot as a major owner in Les Cruots ou Vignes Blanches, with plots inherited through the Jayer family. No cadastral references in the public preview.
